name: Patch selection under predation risk (Mangel & Clark 1988, ch. 2)
description: A forager chooses one of three patches each period. Patch 1 is safe but has no food; patches 2 and 3 offer food with increasing probability and increasing predation risk. Metabolic cost is 1 unit per period in every patch. The forager dies if reserves fall to x_crit = 3. Terminal fitness is survival (1 if alive at T). PROVENANCE: parameters as transcribed by NotebookLM from the book PDF in Mike Heithaus's 2026-09-16 session (beta = 0, 0.004, 0.020; lambda = 0, 0.4, 0.6; food Y = 0, 3, 5; cost alpha = 1; x_crit = 3; C = 10). The book's printed F(x,t) table was not available to check against; see README 'Verification'.
